briefdescription.para: Real-time collaboration and optimistic locking for shared projects.

detaileddescription.para:
Features ─────────
Project sharing with per-user permission levels.
In-process event callbacks (subscribers) invoked synchronously on each notifyChange() call with latency ≤ 5 ms under normal load.
Optimistic object locking: a lock is held by a single locker_id and must be explicitly released.
Append-only in-memory change log queryable by timestamp.

Sharing model ───────────── Sharing requires an explicit user-consent grant. Calling shareProject() without a valid user User::id results in Status{false, "permission_denied"}. Cross-project sharing permission delegation is planned for Q4 2026.
Thread-safety ───────────── All methods are thread-safe. subscribe() and notifyChange() use separate fine-grained locks so that long-running callbacks do not block incoming writes.
RocksDB key layout (persistent entries) ──────────────────────────────────────── collab_share:<project_id>:<user_id> → permission string collab_change:<project_id>:<ts_ns> → Change JSON
